title: Ukraine Strikes Drone Launch Sites in Crimea and Donetsk, Destroys Buk-M3 in Bryansk
detail: Ukraine's General Staff said its Defense Forces struck a series of Russian military targets on August 28-29: attack-drone preparation and launch sites near Hvardiiske in occupied Crimea, an electronic warfare system near Znamenka in Crimea, UAV launch and storage facilities in the city of Donetsk, and a drone command post in Berestky, Donetsk Oblast. Separately, Ukrainian forces confirmed the destruction of a Russian Buk-M3 surface-to-air missile system near Klyntsi in Russia's Bryansk Oblast. The General Staff said the extent of the damage from the Crimea and Donetsk strikes was still being assessed.

media.caption: Ukrainian General Staff report on strikes against drone launch and storage sites in Crimea and Donetsk
